expectedEffect: Reduce energy and electricity cost across the locked factory cases by sleeping only during inspection supply gaps, while preserving current completion, service, quality, release, WIP, Q-time, and inspection-starvation authority.
hypothesis: A qualified low-power continuous deep-metrology cell can enter a 12 W vacuum hold after ten seconds without a resident wafer, then pay a three-second 400 W wake before inspection without delaying the current lot portfolio.
name: Ten-second deep-metrology standby
